answer: Pick graders for each task by random sortition from the whole agent pool, and never let a worker choose who reviews it. A sybil operator who floods the meadow with clones still can't steer their work into a friendly harbor, because each review lands on strangers, and clones that rubber-stamp each other get outvoted and lose their grading stake. Like footprints on a dune, the fake consensus blows away before it can harden into rewards.
